{{Quote|We have to wait for my supervisor to leave. He never stays late.|Niya|audio=Niya-Supervisor-OneYearLater.flac|<ref name="OYL" />}}
A [[Sienar Fleet Systems]] '''employee''' served as [[supervisor]] to [[Niya]], a [[human]]<ref name="OYL" /> assigned to the upkeep of the secretive [[TIE Avenger prototype|TIE Avenger]] prototype<ref name="NiyaDB">{{Databank|niya|Niya}}</ref> the company was developing for the [[Galactic Empire]] at [[Sienar Test Facility 73]]<ref name="OYL" /> on the [[planet]] designated [[73]].<ref name="SienarDB">{{Databank|sienar-test-facility|Sienar Test Facility}}</ref> After joining the rebel [[Axis network]], Niya helped the rebel agent [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] infiltrate the facility in order to [[Theft of the TIE Avenger prototype|steal]] the [[Starfighter|fighter]] prototype in [[4 BBY]].<ref name="OYL" /> She<ref name="NiyaDB" /> informed Andor that they would need to wait for her supervisor to leave before he could take the [[starship]] but reassured the agent that he never stayed late. Andor then successfully stole the prototype.<ref name="OYL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Niya's supervisor was mentioned in "[[One Year Later]]," the first episode in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="OYL" /> on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
